name: Polymarket RTDS Chainlink BTC/USD 60-second TWAP
description: Keyless Polymarket RTDS relay of the Chainlink-computed BTC/USD 60-second TWAP. The adapter subscribes to crypto_prices_twap_sixty with the exact compact btc/usd filter, divides the positive base-10 E18 full_accuracy_value integer by 10^18 using decimal arithmetic, and never uses the display-only numeric value. event_time is the Chainlink observation timestamp; published_at is the outer RTDS timestamp. The stream has no initial snapshot or history, so an opening strike is unavailable unless its exact boundary observation was retained live.
